title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Duty to Report - Suspended Licensee
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: Paralegal X realizes that opposing representation, Paralegal Y, had their license suspended by the LSO last month but is still actively representing clients in ongoing LTB hearings. What is Paralegal X's **first action**?
options: Use the suspension as leverage to force a better settlement for their own client.
Report Paralegal Y's unauthorized practice to the Law Society of Ontario immediately.
Ignore the suspension, as it is the tribunal's responsibility to verify credentials.
Inform Paralegal Y's clients directly that their representative is suspended.
questions.explain: Rule 9.01 outlines the duty to report misconduct to the Law Society. Practicing law or providing legal services while suspended constitutes unauthorized practice and raises a substantial question regarding the licensee's honesty and trustworthiness. It triggers a mandatory duty to report.
